message.text:
No Redis is configured. The cache layer uses an in-memory store at `store/cache`. User entries expire after 10 minutes via `DefaultTTL` in `store.New`.

User entries use `Set()` with the default TTL. No per-user custom TTL exists.

r01.
There is no Redis cache. User entries live in the in-process `store/cache.Cache` created in `store/store.go` with `DefaultTTL` 10 minutes (`userCache.Set` uses that default; no per-user TTL).
